title: az devops invoke --area distributedtask --resource environments --route-parameters project=${project} --query-parameters $top=101 --api-version 7.1 --output json
description: The project's environments, 101 at most, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:environments-list) for forge/ado:environments and forge/ado:deployments, and folds in `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::ado_environments): az devops invoke shows no continuation token, so a 101st fails the read. every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. Each is an EnvironmentInstance, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/distributedtask/environments/list?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1, the list wrapped in {count, value} as invoke prints one.
